prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original fantasy tactical-game character sprite, idle pose
Primary request: Reconstruct the original combat shaman shown in reference image 1 as a fresh, clean, chunky matte illustration in the rendering style of reference image 2. Reference 1 establishes the entire character identity and equipment; reference 2 is only the approved shape, outline, and shading style.
Subject: The original olive-skinned, pointy-eared mature fantasy humanoid, with a broad serious face, heavy dark brows, long dark locks tied into a high rear knot, a few hanging locks and small orange hair beads. Preserve the ivory fur shoulder trim, rusty brick-brown long coat, brown sleeves and leather wrist wraps, broad dark belt and simple square brass buckle, dark trousers, broad brown leather footwear, and the blue-gray circular neck medallion with simple surrounding beads. Large expressive head, large hands, short sturdy limbs and oversized broad feet.
Equipment: Preserve exactly one small round tan-hide drum with a brown wooden shell and broad rope lacing, hanging at the screen-left hip beneath the resting screen-left hand. Preserve exactly one tall brown wooden staff held by the screen-right hand, with the same two-pronged curved fork at its top, purple bindings and a few broad muted blue and brown hanging tassels. Keep the identity, palette, anatomy and equipment arrangement of reference 1. Simplify small ornament into bold readable shapes rather than adding detail.
Pose and framing: Full-body relaxed alert idle, three-quarter view facing screen-right, both feet planted apart, left hand resting near the drumhead and right hand holding the staff upright. One character only, centered on a generous landscape canvas, complete hair, staff, tassels and soles fully visible with transparent clearance on every edge. Body occupies roughly 82 percent of canvas height; keep natural room beside staff. No text, labels, panels or extra poses.
Style: Match reference 2's chunky tactical sprite language: bold dark outer contour, broad matte cel-shaded color planes, simple low-frequency facets, clear head and hand silhouettes, very legible at a 44-pixel standing-body height. Keep the original source palette. No fine textile texture, scratches, stippling, photorealism, shiny rendering or decorative microdetail.
Background: Native genuine RGBA transparency. No colored background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no scenery, no ground oval, no cast shadow, no glow, haze, aura, smoke or floating effects. Clean opaque character interior with only a narrow antialiased silhouette edge. All outer image-edge pixels must be fully transparent.
